Serves as the primary liaison for Chancellor-related events, providing strategic coordination and oversight of meetings, receptions, dinners, and special events to ensure alignment with university protocol, institutional priorities, and executive standards. Advises on ceremonial practices and executive etiquette to support high-profile engagements involving the Chancellor. Serves as the primary administrative liaison to the Associate of the Chancellor, ensuring effective coordination of Chancellor- and university-related initiatives and operations. (10% time)
